svg.title: P0 baseline — desktop 1440x900 cold start in the current build
svg.desc: Annotated wireframe of the shipped PLACE cold start at desktop 1440x900, marking the three mechanical causes of the planning-ambito discovery failure. Static sketch; no interactive behaviour is claimed.

Counts derived from data/planning/madrid_ambitos.geojson and js/planning-ambito.js (createPlanningIndex → ambitosIntersecting) on origin/main @ a4e28d1.
Viewport counts are Web-Mercator bounding-box intersections at zoom 14 centred on 40.415, −3.692 — geometry arithmetic, not a rendering measurement.
A vertex inside a theoretical rectangle is NOT a rendered, unoccluded or discoverable polygon: the shipped build draws none of them. Real-browser verification at all three widths is AC-P0-13.
Panel figures (41 / 63 / 24) are layout placeholders, not evidence readings. NOT TESTED: no human user, no real hardware, no assistive technology, no browser render.
